description: All-local Ollama profile for a single 8GB-VRAM host. Every class resolves to an installed model and requires no external API key. Bindings intentionally reproduce the pre-broker DARCI_OLLAMA_* routing exactly, so introducing the model broker changes no behavior. See host-profile.claude.example.json for a hybrid profile.

chat.fast.note: ASPIRATIONAL: no genuinely small model is installed, so this is the same 9B as chat.balanced. Pull llama3.2:3b (~2GB) to make this tier real.

chat.deep.note: ASPIRATIONAL: mapped to the balanced model on purpose. llama3.3 (42GB) is installed but impractical on an 8GB card - heavy CPU offload makes it minutes-per-call. Point this at a larger local model or the Claude profile when one is available.

classify.intent.note: The doc suggests a dedicated classifier (Lizzy/ONNX); none is wired in this repo yet.

code.fast.note: Same model as code.generate today; kept as a distinct class so the fast/full distinction the code already makes is preserved.
